data.body: Survey checkpoint. Root validation confirmed that new manifest writes use DSSE operation certificates with SSHSIG. Legacy HMAC material remains only for limited compatibility paths, while fourteen maintained documentation surfaces still describe HMAC as the current gate mechanism. Import help still promises duplicate creation and future batching even though cold-stall-chalk delivered source-id idempotency, deferred push, chunked commits, and crash resumption. Workflow validation confirmed that JIRA_PROJECT is required by the bridge runner but omitted from workflow preflight. The identity setup guide incorrectly rejects GITHUB_ENV even though four shipped workflows use it for later steps. The first-change guide contradicts make hooks, the Gerrit-only landing path, and the policy against retrying unproven flakes. The docs index also classifies completed plans, handoffs, and validation transcripts as durable documentation even though the supplied taxonomy assigns that history to tickets. No project files changed.
